explication: Spring PetClinic is a Spring Boot veterinary-clinic sample. Its user-facing workflow covers owner and pet records, visits, and veterinarian listings, rendered as web pages; README also documents H2 by default and MySQL/PostgreSQL profiles. Source excerpts were not provided for runtime Java modules, so relationships between these components are shown only where the README supports them, or marked unverified.
